🎃 FRIGHT NIGHT UPDATE: MY PLAYER 5v5!
👍 Enjoying it? Like + favorite for more updates!

⚽ Next-gen football (soccer) on Roblox: real ball physics, one-touch passing, volleys, headers, skill moves and broadcast-style matches.

⭐ MY PLAYER: create your pro, pick your position and play LIVE 5v5 with players from every server. Level up, earn skill points, chase 99 overall.
🏆 ONLINE SEASONS: climb 10 divisions to Elite.
🃏 DREAM SQUAD: open packs and build your ultimate team.
🎮 Plus Quick Match, Player & Manager Career, Tournaments and Skill Games.

🆕 NEW: full console controller support, cleaner menus, smoother online shots, and assists + challenges that count in every mode.
🎃 FRIGHT NIGHT (until Nov 8): Fright Pass, candy shop and Halloween gear.

📱 Phone, tablet, console and PC.
🎁 Codes: FRIGHTNIGHT • MYPLAYER • RFC27
⭐ Premium: +10% match coins, +25 gems a day.
👥 Join the RFC 27 group for free gear!
💎 Optional store. Drop rates are always shown before you open.
